ps auxww | grep -E '[r]edis-server|[v]alkey-server'; ls -l /opt/redis-7.2/bin /etc/redis-old/redis.conf /etc/valkey/valkey.conf; command -v valkey-cli redis-cli; ss -ltnp | grep -E ':(6379|6380)'

cat /etc/redis-old/redis.conf /etc/valkey/valkey.conf; redis-cli -p 6379 INFO server | head -25; valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO server | head -25; redis-cli -p 6379 INFO keyspace; redis-cli -p 6379 INFO replication; valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO replication; valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO keyspace

redis-cli -p 6379 MODULE LIST; redis-cli -p 6379 CONFIG GET databases appendonly; valkey-cli -p 6380 CONFIG GET databases appendonly; valkey-cli -p 6380 REPLICAOF 127.0.0.1 6379; sleep 2; valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO replication; redis-cli -p 6379 INFO replication; tail -35 /var/log/valkey/valkey.log

for i in $(seq 1 30); do s=$(valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO replication); echo "$s" | grep -E 'role:|master_link_status:|master_sync_in_progress:|slave_repl_offset:|master_repl_offset:'; if echo "$s" | grep -q 'master_link_status:up' && echo "$s" | grep -q 'master_sync_in_progress:0'; then break; fi; sleep 1; done; valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO keyspace; tail -20 /var/log/valkey/valkey.log

cat > /tmp/check_migration.py <<'PY'
import redis
s=redis.Redis(host='127.0.0.1',port=6379,decode_responses=False)
d=redis.Redis(host='127.0.0.1',port=6380,decode_responses=False)
counts={}; groups=0
for db in range(16):
 s.execute_command('SELECT',db); d.execute_command('SELECT',db)
 sk=set(s.scan_iter()); dk=set(d.scan_iter())
 assert sk==dk,(db,len(sk),len(dk),len(sk-dk),len(dk-sk))
 counts[db]=len(sk)
 for k in sk:
  typ=s.type(k)
  assert typ==d.type(k),(db,k,'type')
  if typ==b'string': a,b=s.get(k),d.get(k)
  elif typ==b'list': a,b=s.lrange(k,0,-1),d.lrange(k,0,-1)
  elif typ==b'set': a,b=s.smembers(k),d.smembers(k)
  elif typ==b'zset': a,b=s.zrange(k,0,-1,withscores=True),d.zrange(k,0,-1,withscores=True)
  elif typ==b'hash': a,b=s.hgetall(k),d.hgetall(k)
  elif typ==b'stream':
   a,b=s.xrange(k),d.xrange(k)
   assert a==b,(db,k,'stream entries')
   ga,gb=s.xinfo_groups(k),d.xinfo_groups(k)
   def norm(g):return {x: g[x] for x in (b'name',b'consumers',b'pending',b'last-delivered-id',b'entries-read',b'lag')}
   assert list(map(norm,ga))==list(map(norm,gb)),(db,k,'groups',ga,gb)
   for g in ga:
    name=g[b'name']; groups+=1
    ca,cb=s.xinfo_consumers(k,name),d.xinfo_consumers(k,name)
    assert [(x[b'name'],x[b'pending']) for x in ca]==[(x[b'name'],x[b'pending']) for x in cb],(db,k,name,'consumers')
    pa=s.xpending_range(k,name,'-','+',100000)
    pb=d.xpending_range(k,name,'-','+',100000)
    assert [(x['message_id'],x['consumer'],x['times_delivered']) for x in pa]==[(x['message_id'],x['consumer'],x['times_delivered']) for x in pb],(db,k,name,'pending')
   continue
  else: raise ValueError((db,k,typ))
  assert a==b,(db,k,'value')
  ta,tb=s.pttl(k),d.pttl(k)
  assert (ta<0)==(tb<0) and (ta<0 or abs(ta-tb)<3000),(db,k,'ttl',ta,tb)
 print('db',db, 'keys',len(sk)) if sk else None
print('verified',sum(counts.values()),'keys and',groups,'stream consumer groups')
PY
python3 /tmp/check_migration.py

set -e; redis-cli -p 6379 INFO replication | grep -E 'slave0|master_repl_offset'; valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO replication | grep -E 'role:|master_link_status:|master_sync_in_progress:|slave_repl_offset:|master_repl_offset:'; valkey-cli -p 6380 REPLICAOF NO ONE; valkey-cli -p 6380 SAVE; valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO replication | grep -E 'role:|connected_slaves:|master_host:'; valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO keyspace; redis-cli -p 6379 INFO keyspace; ls -lh /var/lib/valkey/dump.rdb; grep -inE '^\s*(replicaof|slaveof)\b' /etc/valkey/valkey.conf || true; python3 /tmp/check_migration.py
